approval_scope: All sixteen exact original startup PNGs directly opened with view_image; English/Traditional Chinese, simple/workbench, plain/Unicode-space, producer 2022 and consumer 2025. Visual startup release gate only.
limitations: Approval is for the directly inspected static startup pixels and visible primary controls only; this receipt does not independently verify provenance or OS identity, which are separately bound by native artifact gates.
Not a claim of interactive GUI behavior, scrolling operation, calculation correctness, engineering validity, or content outside captured viewports.
